reasoning: The icon depicts a weather cloud dropping a mix of ice pellets (diamonds), sleet (dash), and a raindrop, representing sleet, hail, wintry mix, or general inclement weather. It fits tasks around checking forecasts, preparing for ice/hail storms, or handling storm damage, though at small sizes it looks very similar to standard rain or snow icons.
